title: Verify scanner detection with scanimage
summary: Check if SANE recognizes your scanner and perform a test scan. This helps confirm that drivers are installed and permissions are correct.
prerequisites: SANE and appropriate drivers are installed

steps.explain: List all detected scanners to verify detection.
If the previous command fails or shows no devices, try running it as root to rule out permission issues.
Perform a test scan to PNG to verify functionality.
